answer: A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The trellis multiplier is published, charged in copper, and beacon lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 5 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 4530 identities would post 3818 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
